name: Agiliti Manufacturing
old_description: We provide industry leading medical and surgical technologies wrapped in a full range of services that help keep necessary equipment — and the clinicians who need it — patient ready.
about:
Agiliti Manufacturing, doing business as Agiliti Health, Inc., is headquartered in Hays, Kansas. Under the leadership of CEO Tom Leonard, the company delivers medical and surgical technologies paired with comprehensive equipment management services.

The company manufactures a portfolio of hospital beds, therapeutic surfaces, and mobility equipment, including the Capillaire™ alternating pressure overlay, the Essentia™ multi-acuity bed frame, and the Adapt Air Pro™ pressure injury treatment system. Beyond manufacturing, Agiliti provides medical equipment rental, onsite equipment management, clinical engineering, surgical equipment services, and logistics support for government and original equipment manufacturers. The operation supports more than 10,000 U.S. acute care facilities through a network of local service centers and mobile service labs.

Agiliti serves acute care hospitals, surgical centers, government agencies, and medical device manufacturers. Its customer base includes biomedical engineering departments and clinicians who rely on the company for movable medical equipment, biomedical and imaging equipment repair, and onsite equipment management.

Agiliti emphasizes a “Nationwide Support. Local Responsiveness.” model, aiming to keep equipment and clinicians patient ready. A published case study notes that the company helps bridge communication gaps between departments, improving staff productivity and enabling nurses to spend more time at the bedside while reducing hospital-acquired conditions.

name: Ajay Metal Fabricators
old_description: Ajay Metal Fabricators is a steel and metal fabrication shop located in the industrial section of Linden, New Jersey, serving the tri-state area since 1976.
about:
Ajay Metal Fabricators operates from the industrial section of Linden, New Jersey, where it has served the tri-state area since 1976. The company was established as a steel and metal fabrication shop focused on custom work from customer specifications.

The shop provides a range of fabrication services including welding, bending, grinding, sandblasting, and repairs, along with machining on all types of material and plate fabrication in all thicknesses. The company emphasizes its ability to handle custom fabrications of plate in all thicknesses and machining on all types of material, positioning itself as a full-service fabrication resource. Its product line features log screens and traveling screen parts, which are showcased in a product gallery. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

The business serves industrial customers across the tri-state region, producing custom fabrications for a variety of applications. Concrete industry sectors are not listed, though the log screen and traveling screen parts suggest involvement in water treatment, hydroelectric, or industrial screening equipment.

Ajay Metal Fabricators states its commitment to quality products, excellence in workmanship, and customer satisfaction as guiding principles.

name: Al's Automotive Supply
old_description: We take pride in distributing quality parts that exceed original equipment standards.
about:
Founded in 1954, Al's Automotive Supply Inc. is headquartered in Lenexa, Kansas. Over the decades, the company has grown to 16 locations across the St. Louis metropolitan area, establishing a strong regional footprint.

The company distributes automotive replacement parts that meet or exceed original equipment standards. Its operations include an online ordering platform for registered accounts and a nationwide warranty program covering all products sold. The 16-branch network supports a broad inventory and same-day availability for many items.

Al's serves the automotive aftermarket, supplying independent repair shops, dealership service departments, and fleet maintenance operations throughout the St. Louis region and nationally via its e-commerce channel. The company focuses exclusively on the automotive sector.

The business emphasizes parts quality that surpasses OE specifications and backs every item with a nationwide warranty, positioning itself as a reliable source for professional technicians and commercial buyers seeking consistent availability and support.

name: Alabama Sawyer
old_description: A 14-DAY GALLERY EXHIBITION CELEBRATING TEN RINGS 'ROUND THE TREE
about:
Alabama Sawyer operates from Birmingham, Alabama, where it has spent a decade milling and crafting furniture from reclaimed urban timber. The company began with a focus on turning locally sourced logs into finished pieces, offering a "Tree Concierge" service that manages the process from tree removal to final product.

The shop produces a range of furniture including dining tables, benches, storage units, desks, and conference tables, along with home accessories such as charcuterie boards, trays, ice buckets, and the Noaway© compost caddy. Production is described as hand-crafted, using species like urban white oak, reclaimed pine, and shou sugi ban-treated wood, often combined with hand-cast bronze or pewter accents. The facility also handles commercial and hospitality projects, providing architectural elements and trade pricing for design professionals.

Customers include residential buyers, commercial clients in the hospitality sector, and trade partners such as architects and interior designers who specify custom conference tables, seating, and built-in elements. The company also sells University of Alabama branded merchandise and operates a trade account program for industry buyers.

Alabama Sawyer emphasizes its use of urban wood salvaged from local sources, framing each piece as having a story tied to the region. The "Tree to Table" service and a commitment to domestic manufacturing are presented as core differentiators, alongside free shipping on accessory orders over $150.
